task.title: Delete your saved autofill form information in Chrome
task.shortdesc: Learn how to delete your saved autofill form information in Chrome.

taskbody.p: To delete all of your addresses, payment methods or other saved info in Chrome at the same time:

step.cmd: In the top right, select More.
Choose a time range, like Last hour or All time.
Under Advanced, choose Autofill form data.
